_doc: Living art: a card's still painting brought to life in the card shader (assets/shaders/living_art.gdshaderinc,
ArtLiving). THE AUTHORING GUIDE, with every key, layer kind and mask shape, is docs/LIVING_ART.md (the mask
vocabulary is also at the top of tools/cards/living_mask.py). A card with living art never plays its Wan loop.
All positions are in the full picture's UV (0..1 across assets/cards/art/<id>.jpg, y down).
Francesca's entry is the original whirl format (legacy mask keys swirl / flame / sway / figures / still / protect,
described below); every other card paints its masks with 'regions' and may add up to three 'layers'.
Motion: vortex [x, y] is the centre of the whirl; swirl is its flow speed (UV per second) and spiral how much of it
turns inward; churn the amplitude (UV) of a crisp wave running along the whirl's arms; period the flow cycle
in seconds (the drift is reset every cycle, cross-faded, so it never tears).
rise: the extra upward flow of the flames; flicker / glow: how much the flames' light trembles and breathes;
haze: heat shimmer (UV); sway: the flutter of hair and cloth (UV); wind [x, y]: the direction they stream;
embers: density 0..1 of the sparks drawn on the whirl (0 = none); ember_color.
The mask (assets/cards/living/<id>.png, written by tools/cards/living_mask.py from 'mask' below): R where the whirl
flows, G the flames, B the hair and cloth that sway. Faces ('protect') are black in every channel, so nothing ever
bends a face; 'still' shapes (the starlings) keep out of the flow so they keep their shape; 'figures' are polygons
the whirl and the flames go around.

cd_alexander.note: Sunset ride: the red cape streams back, the mane and the tail toss, dust specks glitter in the low sun as they blow past, the evening clouds sail by, the sun breathes on the horizon, dust rises under the hooves.

cd_attila.note: The scourge: the sky behind the horde burns and flickers, ash drifts down, smoke rolls across, the red plume and cape stream, the mane tosses.

cd_capaneus.note: Fire rain: burning drops stream down across the sky, the flames rise and flicker, the smoke rolls up, the firelight trembles on his armour, the plume and the cloak stir.

regions.note: the smoke on the left rolls up

cd_medusa_gate.note: Behind the gate of Dis: the snakes in her hair writhe, her long locks stir, her eyes and the snakes' eyes smoulder, dusk breathes in the far window, grey clouds drift behind the bars.

regions.note: the snakes and the curls of the crown
the long locks on the left

cd_minotaur.note: The fury of Crete: his eyes and the cracks in his hide burn, his chest heaves, the lava river runs and seethes, sparks rise off it, the clouds roll.

regions.note: the lava river runs toward us

cd_nicholas_iii.note: The simonist in his hole: the flames on his soles rise and lick, sparks climb out of the pit, dark smoke rolls up, the firelight trembles on the stone rim and his robe.

cd_old_man_crete.note: The Old Man of Crete: the cracks in his brow and his tears glow like embers, the tears run down into the rivers of Hell that pour from his beard, the fire below flickers and sends up sparks, his hair stirs, fog drifts in the gorge.

regions.note: the rivers pour from his beard

cd_sealed_lids.note: The sealed tombs: small fires flicker along the path and send up sparks, their light trembles on the lids, the clouds drift and fog creeps down the far valley.

regions.note: the lit lid and the tomb's flank

mc_lucifer.note: Cocytus: the icy water ripples and glints, snow drifts down, the fire veins on his chest and his eyes glow, the wings stir, the clouds drift, a flame licks his hip.

regions.note: the clouds between the wings drift
not across the body at the waterline

minos.note: The judge: his eyes and the serpent's burn and pulse, his chest swells slowly, the fires on both sides rise and flicker, smoke drifts up past the pillars and the clouds roll.

minotaur_rampage.note: The Minotaur charges: fire snorts from his jaws, his great body heaves, sparks fly from the shattered ground, his eye and the molten cracks burn, his shaggy mane bristles, the clouds roll.

regions.note: the chest and flank, not the legs

paolo.note: Paolo and Francesca in the black storm: the whirlwind above turns and its red seams smoulder, gusts of ash streak across, the flames flare round them, her hair and red scarf and his cloak whip in the wind.

phlegyas.note: The Styx: the water runs past the boat and ripples, moonlight glints on it and the moon breathes, fog creeps over the far water, the clouds drift, the trees and his hair stir.

regions.note: the Styx runs right to left past the boat
the clouds, not the dark branches

pj_beatrice.note: Beatrice descends: soft light motes drift up around her, gentle shafts of warm light fall through the smoke, her hair and her sleeve's veil float, the flames behind her rise, the clouds billow slowly.

pj_cato.note: Cato on the shore of Purgatory: the sea rolls in and ripples, the sun on the horizon breathes and sparkles on the water, spray rises off the breakers, the evening clouds drift, his mantle's edge stirs.

pj_centaur_escort.note: Nessus at the Phlegethon: the boiling river of blood runs and seethes, steam lifts off it, the flame on his arrow flickers and glows, his long hair and tail stir, the clouds roll behind him.

regions.note: the river of blood runs toward us

pj_dantes_resolve.note: Dante at the gate of Dis: the fires behind the bars rise and flicker, sparks fly up, the dagger's blade gleams, storm smoke rolls across the sky, his cloak stirs.

pj_harpy_of_the_wood.note: The wood of the suicides: the bare branches sway, fog drifts between the far trees, the wounds in the trees glow and their blood trickles, the wing feathers stir.

regions.note: the leaves at the bottom right

pj_homer.note: Homer among the poets: the lyre strings shimmer and warm motes rise off them like the music, warm evening shafts slant across the sky, his white hair and beard stir, the clouds drift, the small fire flickers and sparks, the grass sways.

pj_lion_of_violence.note: The lion of violence: its great mane ruffles and heaves in a hot wind, its eyes burn, its chest swells with the roar, the tail tuft twitches, storm clouds roll behind it.

pj_lucan.note: Lucan on the field of Pharsalia: the laurel leaves rustle, his hair stirs, battle smoke drifts over the fallen army, embers float down from the burning sky, the clouds sail.

turned_back.note: The gate of Dis: firelight breathes and trembles inside the arch, embers drift up out of it, the flames at the threshold lick, fog creeps over the far cliffs and the clouds roll past.

ugolino.note: Ugolino in the ice: blood drips from the skull and its pool glows and pulses, an icy sleet drives across on the wind, the frozen water ripples, a chill fog creeps over the far lake and the sky, his grey hair stirs, the clouds drift.

regions.note: the sleet drives across everything, his face too (light only)

uh_achilles.note: Swift-footed: the cape and the helmet's crest stream back as he runs, the burning sky flickers and sheds sparks, the surf rolls in and its foam glints, the flames at his heels lick up.

regions.note: the surf rolls to the shore

uh_avaricious_hoarder.note: The hoarder strains at his boulder: his back heaves, grit and dust blow through the air, the grey clouds roll, the sunset smoulders and breathes, his ragged hem stirs.

uh_caesar.note: Caesar in Limbo: the crest of his helmet stirs, pale shafts of light sweep through the clouds that roll behind him, glints run over his steel, the cloak's folds breathe.

uh_cut_the_thread.note: The thread of a life is cut: the loose strands drift and quiver, the cut glows and sheds falling sparks, the fire behind the shears flickers and its light trembles on the iron.

uh_dido.note: Dido at her pyre: the flames roar up and throw sparks, the smoke billows, the firelight trembles on her gown, the sea rolls in behind her, her hair stirs.

uh_filippo_argenti.note: Filippo in the Styx: fire runs up his arm and molten drops fall from it, steam rises off the black water, the water heaves, his wild hair stirs, the red clouds smoulder.

regions.note: the fire running up his arm (light only: the arm stays crisp)

uh_penthesilea.note: The Amazon queen rides into the wind: her cape, hair and plume stream back, the horse's mane and tail toss, grit blows past, the clouds race, the sunset glows on the horizon.

regions.note: grit blows past in the wind of the ride

uh_semiramis.note: Semiramis in her palace: the heavy curtain stirs, the sunset clouds drift over Babylon, its windows flicker with lamplight, slow shafts of evening light sweep in through the window, her hair stirs.

regions.note: shafts of the setting sun from the window

uh_turned_away.note: The three beasts bar the hill: the lion's mane stirs, the tails twitch, their eyes catch the light, haze drifts over the far hills, the sunset glows and the clouds roll.

regions.note: haze drifts over the far hills, behind the beasts

wr_athamas.note: Athamas raves on the shore: lightning flickers in the storm, the clouds race, his cape and wild hair whip in the gale, the surf breaks and its foam glints.

wr_erichtho.note: Erichtho calls up a shade: the ghost wavers and glows pale, its wisps trail and rise, the moon breathes behind the drifting clouds, the campfire flickers, her hair, rags and a torn banner stir.

wr_gate_slams_shut.note: The gate of Dis slams shut: the furnace beyond roars through the bars, flames rise over the spikes with heat shimmer, sparks fly up past the iron, smoke rolls off to the left.

wr_mob_turns.note: The wrathful turn on one of their own: firelight trembles on the crowd, embers drift up, the bare branches sway, the clouds drift and the water churns out from the struggle.

regions.note: the water churns out from the struggle

wr_rancorous_shade.note: A rancorous shade surges out of the Styx: the fire behind the mob roars and sheds embers, the smoke rolls, his eyes burn, his wild hair whips, the black water heaves and splashes glint.
